intro: Herbalism picks herbs from the plants that grow across the world. Alchemy brews them into potions and elixirs, so the two go well together. It needs no tool.

Ranks: Apprentice at any level; Journeyman from skill 50, Expert from 125 and Artisan from 200, at the trainers in every capital and the larger towns. The trainers in the starting areas teach only up to 75. Tanaris and Searing Gorge have no trainer, so Artisan comes before the trip there. On Zephras Isle the quest Harvesting Windstones offers Wild Harvest, which teaches Herbalism.

Optional skill bonuses: Enchant Gloves - Herbalism (+2) or Advanced Herbalism (+5), Herbalist's Gloves (+5, a world drop), Apothecary Gloves (+2, from the Horde quest Serpentbloom in Thunder Bluff) and Goldthorn Tea (+15 for a while; its recipe comes from Henry Stern in Razorfen Downs and needs Cooking 175). With +5, Kingsblood can be picked from 120.

steps.tip: No character level needed. On Zephras Isle, Wild Harvest from Harvesting Windstones teaches it too.

steps.name: Find Herbs
steps.tip: Herbs show on the minimap. Dying turns it off, and only one kind of tracking is on at a time.
